english.notes:
(i) From 28th June 2022 this offence was extended to cover the commission of an offence under sections 5 to 13 of the Act, for offences committed on or after that date the penalty differs depending on the offence facilitated or arranged: sections 5 or 6 (H100735), section 7 (H100737), sections 8, 9 or 10 (penetration - section 8 H100738; section 9 or 10 H100739; no penetration, section 8 - 10 H100740), sections 11 or 12 (H100741) and section 13 (H100742).
(ii) For attempt of this offence see H7647.
(iii) Provided the victim was under 16, an act done by a person in a country or territory outside the United Kingdom which constituted an offence under the law in force in that country or territory, and would constitute a sexual offence to which this section applies if it had been done in England and Wales or in Northern Ireland, constitutes that sexual offence under the law of that part of the United Kingdom, and provided that person was on 01/09/1997, or who has since become a British citizen or resident in the United Kingdom he/she may have proceedings brought against them in the United Kingdom, section 72.
(iv) A person convicted of this offence who was aged 18 or over or sentenced in respect of this offence to at least twelve months imprisonment is subject to notification and orders as provided by section 80 of the Act (Schedule 3, paragraph 23).

other.penalty:
Either way -
Summary: maximum 12 months imprisonment and / or a fine.
Indictment: maximum 14 years imprisonment.

The maximum penalty on summary conviction was increased from 2nd May 2022, see section 282(2) and (3) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003. This applies only to offences committed on or after that date, see section 282(4). For offences committed before 2nd May 2022 the maximum penalty on summary conviction is 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine.

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
